channels.title: Channels
channels.description: Connect your WhatsApp numbers, Instagram, Messenger and your website chat. Each channel can have its own AI agent.
channels.readOnly: Only admins can connect or change channels.

empty.title: No channels connected yet
empty.description: Connect a WhatsApp number, an Instagram or Messenger account, or add the chat to your website to start receiving messages.

channels.noAgentsYet: You don't have any AI agents yet. Create one to answer your channels automatically.
channels.deleteDescription: You'll stop receiving and sending messages on this channel. Past conversations are kept.
channels.agentDisabledHint: This agent is disabled: the channel is handled by humans only.

typeHint.whatsapp: A WhatsApp Business number (Cloud API). You can connect several.
typeHint.instagram: Direct messages of a professional Instagram account.
typeHint.webchat: A floating chat for your website.
typeHint.tiktok: Direct messages of your TikTok business account.

connect.title: Connect channel
connect.description: Choose where you want to talk to your customers.

whatsapp.tokenHelp: Permanent system-user token with whatsapp_business_messaging and whatsapp_business_management permissions.
whatsapp.verifyTokenHelp: Optional. Leave it empty and we'll generate one and show it to you when done.
whatsapp.webhookHelp: In Meta for Developers → WhatsApp → Configuration, paste this callback URL and the verify token, then subscribe to the "messages" field.

meta.oauthIntro: Log in with Facebook and pick the pages and Instagram accounts to connect. Instagram must be a professional account linked to a page.
meta.manualInstead: I'd rather connect manually with a page token
meta.pageIdForIg: The Facebook page linked to this Instagram account.
meta.manualHelp: Set your Meta app webhook ("page" and "instagram" objects, "messages" field) to this URL. We'll subscribe the page automatically.
meta.pickDescription: Select the pages (Messenger) and Instagram accounts you want to handle here.
meta.expired: The Facebook session expired or no pages were found. Try again from "Connect channel".

error.denied: You cancelled the login or didn't grant the required permissions.
error.not_configured: Facebook login isn't configured on this platform. Use the manual connection.
error.state: The request expired or is invalid. Please try again.
error.exchange: We couldn't get access to your pages. Please try again.
error.no_pages: Your Facebook account doesn't manage any page (or you didn't select one).
error.too_many: You selected too many pages. Try again with fewer.

meta.notEnabled: Direct Facebook and Instagram connection isn't enabled on this platform yet. The Whasalia administrator needs to set up the Meta app (App ID and login configuration).

webchat.title: Chat title
webchat.greetingPlaceholder: Hi! 👋 Send us a message and we'll reply in minutes.
webchat.originsHelp: One per line. Leave empty to allow any website.
webchat.prechatHelp: The visitor fills these in before their first message.
webchat.snippet: Code for your website (paste it before </body>)

done.title: "{name}" is ready
done.webchat: Paste this code on your website to show the chat.
done.whatsapp: Last step: set up the webhook in your Meta app.
done.whatsappFields: In Meta for Developers → WhatsApp → Configuration, paste the URL and the verify token, then subscribe to the "messages" field. Save the token: we won't show it again.

edit.title: Edit "{name}"
edit.credentialsHelp: Saved credentials are never shown. Type a new token only if you want to replace it.

settingsCard.title: WhatsApp and other channels
settingsCard.description: WhatsApp numbers, Instagram, Messenger and the web chat are now managed in Channels. You can connect several numbers and give each one its own AI agent.

marketing.title: Optimized marketing messages
marketing.onboarded: Active: your marketing templates go out through Meta's Marketing Messages API.
marketing.pending: Your marketing templates go out through the regular WhatsApp API. From October 13, 2027 Meta will only take them through the Marketing Messages API: accept its terms once and Whasalia will use it on its own. Same price, better delivery.
marketing.notEligible: Meta says this account can't use the Marketing Messages API. Check for alerts or restrictions in WhatsApp Manager.
marketing.unknown: We don't know yet whether this account can use the Marketing Messages API.
marketing.noWaba: Checking needs the WhatsApp Business Account (WABA) ID on the channel.
marketing.howTo: A business admin has to open WhatsApp Manager → Overview → Alerts → “Accept terms”.
